description: Search for content across wiki pages in a project

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow search results

includeFacets.description: Whether to include faceting in results (default: true)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project to search in. If omitted, the search runs across the organization when supported.

searchText.description: The text to search for in wikis

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

top.description: Number of results to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

name: search_wiki
